name: Auto Organize
description: Automatically organize TV episodes and movies for Jellyfin 12

versions.changelog:
- Jellyfin Server 12, plugin ABI 12, and .NET 10 compatibility.
  - Installable ZIP packaging and plugin-repository manifest support.
  - Dynamic `yyyy.M.d.HHmm` versions generated from compilation time.
  - Subtitle sidecars are paired with incoming movies and episodes before Jellyfin scans them.
  - Matched subtitles move or copy with their media and retain language suffixes.
  - Ambiguous matches and destination conflicts remain untouched to prevent incorrect organization.
